Product Description:
Switch to a cleaner, quieter mowing experience with the Ryobi 38″ Electric Rear-Engine Riding Lawn Mower. Powered by a 100Ah battery, this mower delivers up to 2.5 hours of runtime—enough to cover 2.5 acres—without gas or emissions. The 38-inch 2-blade deck and 12-position manual deck adjustment allow for a precise, even cut, while whisper-quiet operation at just 70 dB ensures you won’t disturb your neighbors.
Equipped with LED headlights, cruise control, and a USB phone charger, the Ryobi Electric Riding Mower combines efficiency and convenience. Simply charge it through a standard 120V outlet, hop on, and enjoy an eco-friendly, low-maintenance mowing experience.
Key Features:
Battery-powered, zero gas or fumes
Up to 2.5 hours runtime on a full charge
Quiet cutting at under 70 dB
38-inch 2-blade deck with 12 manual height adjustments (1.5″ – 4.5″)
Cruise control for easy operation
USB charger for convenience
LED headlights for enhanced visibility
Charges with a standard 120V outlet
This mower is ideal for homeowners seeking a powerful, eco-friendly, and low-maintenance alternative to traditional gas-powered riding mowers.
